operational_contract.P1_reference_difference: D3 absolute 24-reservation profile; TAS on four shared egresses only; SP on three real brake last hops; 55us TC0-6 and 30us TC7 windows in a 100us cycle with coordinated offsets
operational_contract.admissibility: L0-L2 fixed-profile triage accepted; L3 rejected before simulation because CSW.eth[0] service upper bound 539.16 Mb/s < 862.656 Mb/s permanent demand; no clipping
operational_contract.clock_drift_method: For each seed and node, SHA256('p1-v2-official-2026-10:C4:ConstantDriftOscillator:{seed}:{node}'), first 64 bits as unsigned integer u, drift=-50+100*u/(2^64-1) ppm; fixed per execution and independent of traffic RNG streams
operational_contract.evaluation: Apply current P1 flow/application/image/loss/goodput/deadline and queue-stability gates; report technical validity, GCL, sampled sync and continuous-sync status separately; do not retune on failure
operational_contract.retries: Only technically invalid executions may receive one audited replacement at the same seed; valid performance failures are retained and never replaced
